result.title: Zero-Shot Multi-Class Wafer Map Classification with Rule-Ordered Prompts for Large Multimodal Models
result.summary: Wafer-map defect classification often requires labeled data and retraining when production conditions change. We present a training-free six-class framework that combines connected-component highlighting with morphology-, location-, and exclusion-aware prompts for a frozen large multimodal model. On Mixed-WM38 (6,866 maps), multi-region prompting achieves 92.9% macro and 93.8% overall accuracy. On WM811K (9,000 maps), it achieves 79.1% and 81.3%, respectively. Eight alternative rule orders achieve 90.1-91.9% overall accuracy, compared with 93.8% for the selected order.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的多类晶圆图缺陷分类框架，用连通域高亮配合形态、位置与排除规则提示驱动冻结的大型多模态模型，并在 Mixed-WM38 与 WM811K 上报告六类分类准确率及八种规则顺序的对比。
AI.relevance_reason: 显式高亮与排除式提示可视为人工筛选视觉证据的对照做法，且规则顺序带来约 1–4 个百分点差异，可供核查提示结构与位置对视觉证据使用的影响；但该文不涉及 latent 状态或推理机制。
